# Black metal

Type: Metal | Internal ID: BlackMetal | Source: Blast furnace | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): No | Crafting Materials: Black metal scrap x1

# Introduction

Black metal is a crafting material smelted from Black metal scrap. It is used to craft the fourth level of metal-wrought equipment, following Silver.

## Availability

Black metal can be smelted from Black metal scrap in a Blast furnace using Coal as fuel.

## Notes

• Black metal is not used to craft any Armor. The Plains-tier Padded Armor is instead made of Iron.
• Like other metals, Black metal cannot be teleported without a Portal stone.
• It would take 98 Black metal to craft one of each base weapon and shield, and a further 260 Black metal to fully upgrade the gear. This works out to 358 total Black metal.

Categorias: Metals, Materials, Can't be Teleported
